marks.gloss_en: [sold] wrappings -- they buy books
but if they sold a Torah, they do not buy books (the mishnah DENIES this purchase)
and likewise with their surplus: the same restriction on what may be bought governs money left over from such a sale
the mishna: [residents who sold] a synagogue may purchase an ark [with the proceeds]
ובפלוגתא דהני תנאי, דתניא: מה היה בחלקו של יהודה ... ומה היה בחלקו של בנימין -- the Temple divided between tribes (marker דתניא; see header)
in Judah's portion were the Temple mount, the chambers and the courtyards
והאי תנא סבר לא נתחלקה ירושלים לשבטים, דתניא: אין משכירים בתים בירושלים מפני שאינן שלהן (marker דתניא; see header)
houses in Jerusalem are not rented out, because they are not theirs
שמע מינה -- from the innkeepers' taking the hides, it is proper to leave flask and hide at one's inn (no support kind names ש"מ)
Abaye: learn from it that it is proper conduct for a person to leave his flask and the hide at his inn
מיתיבי: the Tursiyim's synagogue in Jerusalem was sold to R' Eliezer -- והא התם דכרכים הוה! a city synagogue was sold
ההיא בי כנישתא זוטי הוה, ואינהו עבדוה -- that was a small synagogue, and they built it themselves
R' Yehuda: the synagogue of the bronze-workers in Jerusalem was sold to R' Eliezer, and he used it for all his needs

מיתיבי (26a.9) ... הא בתי כנסיות ובתי מדרשות מיטמאין, אמאי? הא דכרכין הוו! -- by R' Yehuda's 'only the Temple site', Jerusalem's synagogues are private enough to take nega'im, though they are a city's
אימא: אני לא שמעתי אלא מקום מקודש בלבד -- read 'a sacred site' (= p_yehuda_mekom_mekudash)
R' Yehuda, as the stam's emendation reads him: I heard it only of a SACRED site
Rav Ashi: the synagogue of Mata Mechasya, though outsiders come to it, comes at my discretion -- if I wish I may sell it
'your possession' becomes impure with nega'im; Jerusalem does not
Jerusalem was not apportioned to the tribes
a strip went out of Judah's portion into Benjamin's, and on it the altar was built
Rava: the mishna's restriction holds only where the seven townsmen did not sell in the presence of the townspeople
R' Yochanan: this [clause] is the view of R' Menachem bar Yosei, taught anonymously
R' Menachem bar Yosei's reason: since the people pray in it on fast days and at the maamadot
